climate: Shiraz and Cabernet Sauvignon sit in their sweet spot, so the wines can show the style they are known for.

blurb.text: A region in the Limestone Coast zone of southeast South Australia, along the Riddoch Highway, with a GI since 1999 and about 10,000 acres of vines. Shiraz is 31 percent of plantings, Cabernet Sauvignon 28 and Chardonnay 20.
